scope: Observer resource protection and evidence-integrity follow-up only; local specified static/synthetic regression set, not whole-repository CI or real replay.

checks_before_copy: logical ndarray nbytes including broadcast/strided views
remaining declared storage including 4096-byte header reservation
resource_protection.metadata_limit_scope: Conservative encoded-payload accounting, checked during recursive encoding before constructing the corresponding metadata; not a measured Python heap cap.
resource_protection.hashing: Detached array content is hashed through chunked memoryviews; file SHA256 uses bounded 1 MiB reads. No whole-raster read_bytes or array.tobytes allocation.
resource_protection.comparison: Raster verification uses read-only mmap and the same chunked hashes; semantic log is read line-by-line, but decoded events are retained for strict comparison.
resource_protection.failure_policy: Any limit/copy/hash/write failure invalidates diagnosis out of band without changing business decisions or retry behavior.
resource_protection.limits: These bounds cover observer-controlled payloads/inventory and avoid the identified large duplicate allocations. They do not cap total process RSS, allocator overhead, NumPy internals, OS page cache or the whole offline event list; OS termination and severe pressure remain unvalidated.

evidence_integrity.completion: After summary close succeeds, write and fsync a deterministic pending completion marker, close it, then publish completion. Marker binds the summary SHA256. Missing/unfinished marker causes mismatch_hold.
summary_rules: reject recorded faults even if valid flag says true
semantic array count must equal summary array count
full-capture array occurrences and artifact inventory must match one-to-one in order
reject duplicate file references, missing/orphan raster files, symlinks and unexpected indexed names
verify file digest, dtype, shape and decoded array digest
evidence_integrity.aborted_scope: An uncaught exception leaving observation_session marks evidence invalid and re-raises the same business exception; no completion marker is published.
evidence_integrity.compatibility: New comparator requires summary schema v2 and completion marker; old v1 evidence remains historical and is not silently upgraded or accepted as v2.
evidence_integrity.limitations: Completion hashes detect accidental incomplete/modified evidence; they are not signatures and cannot prevent malicious rewriting of an entire self-consistent evidence directory.

new_cases: both modes reject array/storage/inventory limits before detached-copy callback (six cases)
bounded read sizes in chunked file hashing
full capture and comparison work while Path.read_bytes is forbidden
partial raster write, duplicate reference, orphan file and fault hidden behind valid flag (four cases)
metadata limit leaves actual synthetic executor result unchanged
aborted session preserves exception identity and invalidates evidence
summary-close and completion-close failures leave no accepted completion marker (two cases)
duplicate artifact rejected even with self-consistent edited summary/completion hash
validation.claim_boundary: Local selected static and synthetic checks only. No Python CI claim, no interpretation of Vercel deployment status as test evidence, no real S07 B/C noninterference result.

remaining_before_P3: freeze full observer build commit, actual inputs/case mapping/contracts, runtime/dependencies and resource/storage configuration in a separate execution manifest
separate explicit authorization for S07/U1 and S07/U2 only, A then B then C, at most six witness calls; mismatch/timeout/incomplete evidence stops subsequent arms
execution_preparation_scope: No execution identity manifest is represented as complete here; environment/storage freeze and any authorized deployment remain future work.
